idle.hint: Our cashier will take your order right away

cart.title: Your order
cart.hint: Please review your order. The cashier will collect payment once you confirm.

qr.title: Scan to pay
qr.step2: Scan the QR code on screen

expired.title: QR code expired
expired.hint: Please wait for the cashier to generate a new code.

paid.title: Payment successful
paid.hint: Please wait for your number to be called.

pairing.title: Pair this display with a counter
pairing.subtitle: Enter the code below on the cashier's POS
pairing.retrying: Retrying automatically — please check the Wi‑Fi connection.
pairing.revoked: This display was removed from its counter. Please pair it again.
pairing.step1: On the POS, tap “Customer display” in the cart panel
pairing.step2: Enter the 6-digit code shown on this screen
pairing.step3: The display connects to the counter — no sign-in needed here
pairing.note: Each code works once and changes every 5 minutes. Once paired, reopening the app keeps the pairing.
